EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Time & Attendance Support. When onboarding new employees in Insperity Premier, you will see a "Time and Attendance Management" screen, where supervisor, pay group, accrual group, and other assignments can be made. These will appear as a sequence of drop-down menus, based on your company's setup. Once onboarding is complete, a profile will be immediately created in the Time & Attendance system for that employee without the need to wait for I-9 verification. Generally, no additional steps are needed in the system at that point. Should an incorrect assignment be made during the onboarding process or if an employee's information changes, such as an incorrect supervisor, pay group, or accrual group, the correction can be made in Premier > Manage Employees.
If you have any further questions, please let us know and we will be happy to help.
Thank you,
Technical Support Team
